text.content:
Maelstrom's club, headquarters and garage.

Region: Northside Industrial, Watson (#8)
Controlled by: Maelstrom; Chrome Mother this year
The feel of it: Industrial music, blood on the floor, chrome to the ceiling
Danger: SC 7: Maelstrom, Hardened Medium. Neutral ground for buyers, if you keep your hands visible

Maelstrom's metal jewel, moved to Northside from the edge of the Hot Zone when the crater was cleared in 2052. Every year someone claims the throne here, until someone bigger shows up. The Rust Choir gathers at the door and sings, hoping to be picked.

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.03, 04, 08
